description: The full live-session shape: plan OHP/RDL/Bench/Seated Row/Face Pull/Curls, RDL already skipped (ADD-2 splices it out before recap), OHP/Bench/Seated Row/Face Pull logged, an off-plan Incline Dumbbell Flyes added and logged. The save/review recap must show only the genuinely-undone Curls as remaining -- never a logged or skipped exercise.
